_about: Labelled lines for scripts/commitments/eval-judge.ts. real/junk/unresolved/ambiguous are single caller lines; context (pronouns, run-ons) and tails (a plan, then a goodbye) are short calls with the commitments expected, each as the words its statement must contain (any one of each group). Sources: #1896 fixture (stances moved to junk, lines about Ferni or with an unnamed pronoun moved out of real), the #1896 verifier's writer.tsv/table2/probe2. heldoutReal/heldoutJunk were written after the prompt's examples were fixed and share none of them; the prompt's examples are in no set.

turns.content: My sister Mindy's had a rough week, her landlord's being awful.
Ugh, that sounds stressful for her.
Yeah. I'll call her tomorrow.
Dan from work still hasn't sent the contract.
Still? It's been weeks.
I know, I'll email him about it Monday.
My mom's birthday is Saturday.
Oh nice, any plans?
Not yet. I need to get her something this week.
I owe Tom fifty bucks, I'll pay him back Friday.
Mark needs help painting his deck Sunday and I said I'll do it.
The dentist called and I'm going to call them back tomorrow.
I haven't called my dad in weeks, I'm gonna do that tonight.
Rent's due Friday, I'll pay it Thursday.
The car's making that noise again so I'll take it in tomorrow.
Priya asked me to look over her deck.
That's nice that she trusts you with it.
Yeah, I'll send her notes tonight.
Jake's grades have been slipping.
Is he okay?
I think so, I need to talk to him this weekend.
Ben lent me his drill and I'll return it tomorrow.
My neighbor Carol just got back from the hospital.
Oh, how is she doing?
Okay I think. I'm gonna bring her some soup.
My brother's moving apartments Saturday.
Big job.
Yeah, I told him I'd help him move, so I'll be there at 9.
There's a bill from the hospital, I need to pay it by the 15th.
Grandma's been lonely since grandpa passed.
That's hard.
It is. I'm going to visit her Thursday.
Emma has soccer practice till 5:30.
Who picks her up?
Me today, I'll grab her on my way home.
Kevin covered my lunch last week.
That was kind of him.
I need to send him the forty bucks I owe him.
Sarah starts chemo on Monday.
I'm so sorry. How's she feeling?
Scared. I'll check in on her after.
My therapist wants me to start journaling.
How do you feel about that?
Honestly fine, I'll start tonight.
Biscuit's limping again.
Oh no, poor pup.
Yeah, gonna schedule the vet for him.
Lisa and I keep missing each other.
Busy weeks?
So busy. I'll text her and set up coffee.
I'm gonna call my mom tonight.
She'll love that.
Okay, I'll let you go. Catch you later!
Gotta renew my passport before March.
Good call, those take a while.
Yep. Alright, talk to you tomorrow, take care.
Thanks for listening, I'll think it over.
Anytime.
Okay bye.
Sounds good. Will do.
Talk soon!
Imma head out, peace.
I'll call it a night, I'm wiped.
I'll keep that in mind, thanks.
Of course.
Gotta bounce, ttyl.
